title: OLX.ba Exits & Price Endings
description: Direct views of current listings, recorded price changes, scrape runs, and observed closures in the lean schema. Historical charts use retained event dates and reported daily prices rather than reconstructed inventory.

filters.name: category
filters.label: Category
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT category AS __value FROM lean.saved_searches WHERE category IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

filters.name: rooms
filters.label: Rooms
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(rooms,'unknown') AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1

filters.name: neighborhood
filters.label: Neighborhood
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(neighborhood,'unknown') AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Closed listings · 30 d
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND (${deal}='All' OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND (${deal}='All' OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT count(*) AS closed_30d FROM base WHERE closed_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 30

panels.title: Exit map — click a pin to open the ad

panels.title: Closed & pinned — click title to open

panels.title: Final recorded ask vs cycle opening ask
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND (${deal}='All' OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND (${deal}='All' OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT CASE WHEN b.closing_price<opening.opening_price THEN 'lower' WHEN b.closing_price>opening.opening_price THEN 'higher' ELSE 'same' END AS direction,count(*) AS listings FROM base b JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price AS opening_price FROM lean.price_history WHERE article_id=b.article_id AND source='api_price_history' AND price>0 AND price_date <= b.closed_at ORDER BY CASE WHEN price_date >= b.cycle_opened_at THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,CASE WHEN price_date >= b.cycle_opened_at THEN price_date END ASC NULLS LAST,CASE WHEN price_date < b.cycle_opened_at THEN price_date END DESC NULLS LAST,id LIMIT 1) opening ON TRUE WHERE b.closed_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 90 AND b.closing_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

e.event_type='closed' AND (${deal}='All' OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND (${deal}='All' OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT b.days_listed::float8 AS days_listed, (100.0*(b.closing_price/opening.opening_price-1))::float8 AS final_change_pct,b.title,b.url,b.article_id FROM base b JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price AS opening_price FROM lean.price_history WHERE article_id=b.article_id AND source='api_price_history' AND price>0 AND price_date <= b.closed_at ORDER BY CASE WHEN price_date >= b.cycle_opened_at THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,CASE WHEN price_date >= b.cycle_opened_at THEN price_date END ASC NULLS LAST,CASE WHEN price_date < b.cycle_opened_at THEN price_date END DESC NULLS LAST,id LIMIT 1) opening ON TRUE WHERE b.closing_price IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Observed closure share by final KM/m² bracket
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND (${deal}='All' OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND (${deal}='All' OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT ppm2_bracket,round(100.0*sum(exits)/NULLIF(sum(exits)+sum(actives),0),1) AS exit_ratio FROM (SELECT (floor(closing_ppm2/1000)*1000)::int AS ppm2_bracket,count(*) AS exits,0::bigint AS actives FROM base WHERE closed_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 30 AND closing_ppm2>0 GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT (floor(ppm2/1000)*1000)::int,0,count(*) FROM active WHERE ppm2>0 GROUP BY 1) population GROUP BY ppm2_bracket ORDER BY ppm2_bracket

panels.title: Exit rate by neighbourhood — 30 d
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND (${deal}='All' OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND (${deal}='All' OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT neighborhood,sum(exits) AS exits_30d,sum(actives) AS active,round(100.0*sum(exits)/NULLIF(sum(exits)+sum(actives),0),1) AS exit_ratio FROM (SELECT coalesce(neighborhood,'unknown') AS neighborhood,count(*) AS exits,0::bigint AS actives FROM base WHERE closed_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 30 GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT coalesce(neighborhood,'unknown'),0,count(*) FROM active GROUP BY 1) population GROUP BY neighborhood ORDER BY exit_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
